blocks.text: Harry Kane is set to equal England’s appearance record with his 125th cap against the Czech Republic on Tuesday as the striker looks to build on his flourishing partnership with “scary” Jude Bellingham. Kane will take centre stage if he ties former England goalkeeper Peter Shilton’s landmark in the Nations League clash at Wembley. The England captain’s pride in representing his country has shone through since his debut against Lithuania in 2015.
